versions.name: John Sherman Hoyt Scout Reservation
versions.summary: A Connecticut Yankee Council weekend camping property on wooded forest and fields in West Redding, Connecticut, offering tent and lean-to sites, pavilions, cabins, and hiking trails for troop use.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Connecticut Yankee Council camp page, which confirms it as an active council property maintained for weekend use. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and active weekend-use status verified from the council's own camp page; classified as a short-term/weekend camping property; features unsurveyed.
